## Changelog

## Change type

<!-- Choose one or more that apply -->
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation or project files
- [ ] Refactoring or chore

## Testing

- [ ] Debug and Release tests pass (`ctest --output-on-failure`)
- [ ] Each behavior change has a focused test in `tests/`
- [ ] UI changes were checked at 100x30 and by keyboard and mouse (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit subjects follow `docs/project-standards.md`, with one logical change per commit
- [ ] The Changelog section has the approved wording, or says there is no user-visible change
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, tokens, device identifiers, real inventory data or local paths
